svg.title: Overall Navigation Architecture with AMB3R-Conditioned Heatmap Guidance
svg.desc: A compact hand-drawn-style overview of the preserved InternNav System-2 to System-1 backbone and the new causal AMB3R-conditioned heatmap guidance branch. System-2 uses front-view history and current RGB to produce a pixel goal and trajectory hidden states. A frozen native bridge conditions frozen NextDiT, while structured heatmap tokens enter a trainable zero-gated cross-attention branch in every NextDiT block.
svg.text: Overall Navigation Architecture with AMB3R-Conditioned Heatmap Guidance
goal text becomes part of the context
TRAINABLE ZERO-GATED CROSS-ATTENTION IN EVERY BLOCK ×12
history identity + relative pose + current spatial slots
LABELS SUPERVISE THE HEAD · NEVER MODEL INPUTS AT INFERENCE
SAME K FRAME IDs ALIGN RGB, POSES, MASKS, AND AGES
AMB3R replaces simulator historical relative poses at inference.
ORIGINAL SYSTEM-2 → SYSTEM-1 FLOW IS PRESERVED
Two-stage learning: adapt pose-sensitive fusion/readouts to causal AMB3R poses, then freeze the Head for control training.
